I don't know if I'm reading this wrong, or if it's a typo, but in this particular log it states:

The initial descent into the tunnels consists of five teams, two research and three assault, along with enough equipment to establish an underground base of operations.

But then, later, it goes on to say

Of the four research teams, three were ordered to proceed down the unexplored pathway while an aerial drone was prepped for a second recon of the vertical shaft.

Is it two teams or four?

Either way, this SCP will always hold a special place in my nightmares because of these logs.
